purpose: Observational research cards only, not executable code/configuration. Read-only exact current-source reconstruction plus explicit causal replication requirements; no live-policy, order, cap, stop, resume or variable authorization.
source_common_gates: BTC context available, with decision_time = market.open_time + 5 minutes and now >= decision_time.
first_window BTC rows satisfy market.open_time <= row.ts < decision_time; open reference is first row.open.
decision BTC close is last returned row with market.open_time < row.ts + 1 minute <= decision_time.
signal_minute is ordinal index of latest received Kalshi candle, not separately validated elapsed minute; must be 6 through 10 inclusive.
early_low is minimum side ask_low in first 5 received Kalshi candle rows.
latest side ask_close > minute-5 side ask_close, and latest ask_close > latest ask_open.
seconds_left >= 300 when close_time is available; missing close_time does not block this gate.
current side ask exists and is within lane's inclusive live-ask band.
one entered-signals key per ticker, side and strategy; do not conflate source requests with actual fills.

retired_lane.source_status: Retired 2026-09-22; historical name retained only for display; absent from current configs.
retired_lane.evidence_status: Historical reconstruction from committed first5 recovery report, historical signals snapshot and local entry records at this pin; no current executable predicate branch exists.
retired_lane.latest_candle_recovery: Green side candle and ask_close > minute5 ask_close.
retired_lane.realized_receipt_subset_exit: Seven closed BTC_FADE windows effectively exited70c via ACCOUNT_SYNC; eighth lost at official settlement. This is different from advertised90c policy.

source_execution.default_size: ceil(20% of cash cents / rounded entry cents); omits fee reserve and can exceed intended budget by one contract; if risk_pct=0 uses fixed5.
source_execution.entry: GTC limit buy at rounded current ask, post_only=false; receipt/remaining exposure must be reconciled separately.
source_execution.exit: Separate GTC sell at lane target, once current-market position observed; no ordinary stop-loss or cancellation/repricing lifecycle shown.
source_execution.historical_mismatch: 12 of13 newer-lane receipt windows closed at70c (ACCOUNT_SYNC), including advertised80/90c lanes; one BTC_FADE lost at settlement.

causal_replication_requirements_not_pres: Use actual market window timestamps and Kalshi end_period_ts, reject missing/duplicate/out-of-order minute bars rather than ordinal relabelling.
A candle is usable only after its close time and recorded first-visible receipt time; no same-boundary use of a candle whose ts labels start.
Freeze first5 BTC/EMA inputs from observations received by the declared decision cutoff. Join by completed-candle end <= cutoff, never nearest candle-start close.
Compute 15-minute EMA21 from actual completed 15-minute close buckets; match source clock convention and predeclare warmup/history.
Evaluate latest completed eligible bar6 through10, then use the next available executable side quote after the signal and declared delay; no retrospective close fill.
Require current delayed depth for desired simulated size and preserve unknown fills/queue/cancel outcomes, fees and official settlement losses.
Keep current2lane and historical3lane/realized70c-exit hypotheses distinct; research unit size is fixed for comparison, with no production cap/risk change.
